Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**

**Job ID** R-261745 **Date posted** 10/13/2026

**Job Title: Director - Principal Data Engineering Lead**

**GCL: F**

**Location: Chennai**

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to turn the latest AI breakthroughs into resilient, production-grade systems that accelerate late-stage scientific discovery and move life-changing medicines closer to patients? Can you picture yourself setting enterprise-wide Data and AI strategy while building reusable autonomous frameworks and GenAI capabilities that scale with confidence?

In this role, you will lead how we embed intelligence into the digital backbone of drug development. You will develop long-term platform funding priorities, capability roadmaps, and technology choices. Then you will translate strategy into solutions that make complex enterprise workflows simpler, safer, and faster for our scientists and product teams.

Join us at a pivotal point in our transformation into a digital and data-led enterprise. Backed by investment and an ecosystem of partners, you will work across AI science, engineering and business partners to create patterns that become the standard and prove them through high-impact deliveries that stand up in a regulated environment.

**Accountabilities:**

* Shape and evolve the long-term Data and AI strategy for drug development, including platform investments, capability roadmaps, technology choices and alignment with enterprise architecture.
* Partner with AI science teams to design reusable agentic patterns, GenAI components and scalable solutions that streamline sophisticated enterprise workflows and accelerate delivery.
* Influence enterprise architecture decisions and lead strategic vendor evaluations, pilots and ecosystem partnerships to bring the best technologies into the enterprise.
* Lead multi-functional engineering teams, driving end-to-end delivery from prototype to robust, compliant production systems.
* Define, govern and promote engineering standards, guidelines and reusable design patterns; produce and review detailed technical designs across data models, APIs, integrations, security, deployment, error handling, performance, monitoring, testing and support.
* Promote strong data integrity and governance, including clear ownership, quality management, metadata, lineage, audit trails, master and reference data, and standardized terminology.
* Establish and maintain AI and ML governance controls, covering risk assessment, proper use, human oversight, explainability, model approval, versioning, performance monitoring, change control and retirement.
* Implement production-grade controls for GenAI and retrieval-augmented generation solutions to deliver reliable, traceable and secure outputs based on trusted information, including prompt and model management, response quality testing, source referencing, access controls and mitigations for prompt attacks and data leakage.
* Define and operate comprehensive evaluation and monitoring frameworks that track accuracy, reliability, security, response quality, business relevance, degradation, latency, cost and operational stability.
* Establish API-based and event-driven integration standards, including data formats, contracts, versioning, interoperability and integration with legacy and regulated systems.
* Improve value from enterprise data platforms and guide the implementation of DevOps, DataOps and MLOps practices to deliver resilient, automated, auditable pipelines across data, ML and AI.
* Ensure data solutions adhere to FAIR principles—findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable—and support end-to-end machine learning and AI workflows.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, collaboration, and innovation across engineering and AI teams, encouraging thoughtful use of AI and digital tools in day-to-day work.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**

* Track record of leading end-to-end delivery of AI-native products within a controlled or enterprise environment.
* Demonstrable ability translating research advances in GenAI or agent-based systems into scalable industrial solutions.
* Deep knowledge of modern cloud and data architecture patterns: microservices, serverless, etc.
* Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), SQL/NoSQL databases, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Fluency in Python, with a good understanding of secure software engineering practices.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading high-performing teams.
* Comfortable influencing senior partners and shaping technology strategy across functions.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**

* Pharma industry experience, particularly in R&D or Late-Stage Development.
* AI or Gen AI technical certifications or equivalent.
* AWS Cloud Certification or equivalent.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

**Why AstraZeneca:**

Here, your work directly accelerates the development of life-changing medicines by pairing leading science with modern data platforms, analytics and AI. You will join a community that brings unconventional combinations of expertise together to spark bold thinking, supported by real investment and the freedom to experiment—from hackathons to high-impact deliveries in production. title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
TechGrove is the **Centre of Excellence** for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan's global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India's deep pool of technical talent with Banyan's long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

**About Berkeley Myles**  
We build software for UK manufacturers who can't afford to get things wrong: aerospace, medical devices, oil and gas, motorsport. Our product, ProgressPlus, runs the whole job from first enquiry through to final invoice. Hundreds of manufacturers run on it every day, and when one of them has to prove what went into a part, it's where the answer comes from. We're now building a new product with AI on every stage of that flow.  
We're part of Banyan Software, the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialised industries, their employees, and their customers. Banyan is a Great Place to Work Certified company, a five-time Inc. 5000 honoree, and a top-10 company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500.  
Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Atlanta, Banyan operates more than 100 portfolio companies across North America, the UK, the EU, and APAC.

**About the Role**  
A manufacturer runs one flow: enquiry, quote, order, jobs, scheduling, tracking, quality, shipping, invoice. ProgressPlus is the system of record for that flow. We're building the system of action on top of  
it: AI that works on every stage, capturing enquiries, validating orders, optimising schedules, anticipating problems, and reconciling invoices, always with a human in control and every step  
auditable. You'll be the company's first AI engineer. There's not much AI in production today: no agents, no runtime, no AI layer. You'll build the system of action from a blank page. It has two parts: the events that announce what just happened in the business, and the agents that act on them. Agents that plan multi- step work, run in the background, act under their own identity with bounded authority, and leave a trail a regulated manufacturer can show an auditor. The ground is prepared. Five .NET services with architecture boundaries enforced in CI, and a growing catalog of transaction-safe business operations ready to become AI tools. This is a founding role: you set the architecture, the standards and the evaluation discipline that every AI feature in this product gets built on.

**Key Responsibilities**  
Build the agentic layer: one coherent layer that every AI capability in the product runs on. Once it exists, adding AI to any stage of the manufacturing flow is a few weeks of feature work.  
The runtime and the tools Architect the agent runtime: a server-side loop with durable runs, retries, scheduled and event-driven triggers, and human-in-the-loop steps  
Build the tool layer that turns our catalog of transaction-safe business operations into typed, tenant- scoped, permissioned AI tools, for our own agents and for the outside world through MCP  
Evaluation and audit Make evals part of how we ship: fixture-based tests of every AI behaviour, wired into CI from day one Close the correction loop: every override, rejection and edit captured as structured signal, so evals and retrieval improve from real use Build agent auditing into the platform's tamper-evident action log as it lands: every agent step logged, attributable and replayable. Our customers pass AS9100 audits, and explainable AI is a  
feature we sell Grounding and operations Drive the event catalog: which business facts the product announces, from the office to the shop floor (SalesOrderCreated, GoodsReceived, JobRunningLate). Every agent run starts from one Grow the semantic grounding: a machine-readable model of the business and how it fits together, so agents retrieve facts instead of inventing them  
Own the agent authority model: what an agent may do, its budget, how much autonomy each workflow gets. Instrument the runtime so every step is metered and traced  
Run what you ship: your agents in production are yours, including the incident when one misbehaves

What Success Looks Like  
First three months: one real workflow runs end to end on the agent runtime in production, with its evals in CI and every step in the audit log.  
First six months: more agents are live on the same layer, and at least one of them was built by one of the full stack engineers.  
First twelve months: adding AI to a stage of the flow is a few weeks of feature work for any engineer here, and you can show an auditor how any of it reached the answer it did.

How We Work  
Linear as the single board: work traced from issue to acceptance criteria to PR, reporting as a by- product of the work  
A small team: full stack engineers with a lead, plus AI and platform specialists, on a .NET and Next.js platform on Azure Prototype-led: we design the flow before we build it, against a shared design system  
AI in daily use across the team: coding agents in the repo with the context they need, and AI tooling  
for research, prototyping and analysis  
A customer base we can pick up the phone to, and an implementation team on their sites every week

**Tech Stack You'll Use**  
Backend: C#, .NET 10, Rebus messaging, SQL Server (database per company)  
Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript  
Cloud: Azure (Container Apps, Azure SQL, Service Bus, Front Door), Bicep, GitHub Actions  
AI: Model-agnostic by design, with MCP as the tool protocol  
Tooling: Claude Code, Linear, GitHub

**What We're Looking For**
  
You've taken multiple LLM-powered systems from prototype to production, at least one of them agentic (multi-step, tool-using, running unattended), and you can walk us through what broke and  
what you'd redo Product instincts and a builder's disposition: you can sit with a planner or a quoting manager, translate their workflow into an agent architecture without being handed a spec, then write the code,  
ship it, and talk to the people who use it Strong backend and systems engineering experience (5+ years). You've built event-driven systems,  
you can explain why the transactional outbox exists, and you think in contracts, idempotency and failure modes  
You treat evals and observability as part of the definition of done, and you've wired LLM evaluation and observability tooling  
You treat AI security as an engineering problem: injection containment, retrieved content handled strictly as data, and hostile inputs in the eval suite  
Clear opinions on build versus buy: you know which parts of an agent stack to take from providers and which parts you have to own  
Comfortable being first: setting standards, writing them down, and reviewing others' work against them  
Strong written communication: you'll work with a team split across time zones  
Preferred Experience  
You've shipped something in manufacturing, ERP, supply chain or industrial operations, or you're genuinely curious about how factories run  
Document extraction pipelines: structured extraction from PDFs and email, OCR cascades, confidence-scored human review

Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

**Protect yourself by following these steps:**

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.
